entries.265809518ca9adf5: This is a single-segment business that uses iron scrap as the main raw material, melts steel in electric furnaces, and manufactures and sells steel materials such as bar steel, wire rod, and shaped steel, as well as processed products for civil engineering and construction. Production is based at its Nagaoka, Sanjo, Kumoide, Mitsuke, and Kitakata plants; consolidated subsidiary Cortex Co., Ltd. processes and sells the products, and Metal Transport Co., Ltd. handles transport. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,598 million, and its main customers are ITOCHU Marubeni Sumitomo Techno-Steel Corporation and Hanwa Co., Ltd. Overseas sales are less than 10% of revenue.
